excluded: complete TCP and general content/output/timing or implementation refinement proof
limited transmit, NewReno/SACK/ECN and RFC7661 window validation

IDLE-RESTART.interpretation: September2009 section4.1: SHOULD reduce cwnd to no more than RW=min(IW,cwnd) before transmission when no data sent for an interval strictly exceeding RTO. Apply the exact RW on an explicit queued new-data transmit opportunity, including blocked attempts; clear accumulated CA credit conservatively. Preserve ssthresh. Receive requests and ACKs do not refresh the data-send clock.
IDLE-RESTART.strength: finite idle restart before new-data scheduling

IDLE-HISTORY.interpretation: Record only actual nonempty tcp_data emissions at their IR emission point: new data, fast/timeout retransmit and zero-window probes. Pure ACK, SYN, FIN-only, app.send, blocked transmit and clock advance do not refresh. First data has no prior data-send history; connection cleanup clears validity. No host callbacks.

IDLE-SOURCE.interpretation: Module-local RFC5681 version, sections and raw-byte SHA binding.

IDLE-SCOPE.interpretation: Finite SMSS4/queue16 overlay. Shared current RTO and sequence/history semantics; no independent idle timer, configurable enable switch or automatic transmit. Not RFC7661 congestion-window validation, limited transmit, NewReno/SACK, complete TCP or implementation proof.
